gloss: kenchin soup; vegetable and tofu soup

definitions.gloss: kenchin soup; clear vegetable and tofu soup
definitions.explanation: A clear soup made by stir-frying crumbled tofu and root vegetables such as daikon, carrot, and burdock, then simmering them in a soy-based broth. A common home and temple dish, especially in cold weather.

notes:
A hearty soup of tofu and root vegetables. Said to originate in Buddhist temple cooking (⟦{精進料理|しょうじんりょうり}→精進料理：16101_shoujinryouri⟧), so the classic version uses no meat or fish.

- けんちん{汁|じる}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{煮|に}る→煮る：01971_niru⟧: to simmer kenchin soup
- ⟦{具|ぐ}だくさん→具だくさん：15063_gudakusan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧けんちん{汁|じる}: kenchin soup full of ingredients

- ⟦{豚汁|とんじる}→豚汁：14229_tonjiru⟧: pork-and-vegetable miso soup — contains pork and is miso-based
